q: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
He who fears death will never do anything worthy of a man who is alive.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
If you are pained by external things, it is not they that disturb you, but your own judgment upon them.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
Difficulty shows what men are.
Happiness is a good flow of life.
The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury.
Man conquers the world by conquering himself.
He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not, but rejoices for those which he has.
The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
Ignorance is the mother of fear.
If you want to improve, be content to be thought foolish and stupid.
Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together, but do so with all your heart.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
When you arise in the morning think of what a privilege it is to be alive, to think, to enjoy, to love.
Choose not to be harmed and you won't feel harmed. Don't feel harmed and you haven't been.
It is the power of the mind to be unconquerable.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
Don't explain your philosophy. Embody it.
Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
How long are you going to wait before you demand the best for yourself?
Never let the future disturb you. You will meet it, if you have to, with the same weapons of reason which today arm you against the present.
Cato used to say that he had rather men should ask why he had no statue erected for him, than why he had one.
Small acts of virtue, performed quietly, build an unshakeable soul.
Freedom is the only worthy goal in life. It is won by disregarding things that lie beyond our control.
Fate leads the willing, and drags the unwilling.
To live a good life: We have the potential for it. If we can learn to be indifferent to what makes no difference.
A gem cannot be polished without friction, nor a man perfected without trials.
If a man knows not which port he sails to, no wind is favorable.
Suffer not the burdens of tomorrow before they arrive; today has enough of its own.
I begin to be a friend to myself. That is a great gain, for such a person can never be lonely.
Look back over the past, with its changing empires that rose and fell, and you can foresee the future, too.
You can commit an injustice by doing nothing, not just by doing something.
Associating with people of good character will inspire you to reach for higher ground.
When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
Silence is a source of great strength.
Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner.
Life is a series of natural and spontaneous changes. Don't resist them; that only creates sorrow. Let reality be reality.
When you are content to be simply yourself and don't compare or compete, everyone will respect you.
Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.
Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
You only lose what you cling to.
In the end, only three things matter: how much you loved, how gently you lived, and how gracefully you let go of things not meant for you.
The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
Don't grieve. Anything you lose comes round in another form.
The quiet you keep within yourself radiates outward into everything you touch.
I wish I could show you when you are lonely or in darkness the astonishing light of your own being.
Where there is love, there is no fear.
You are not a drop in the ocean. You are the entire ocean in a drop.
Clouds come floating into my life, no longer to carry rain or usher storm, but to add color to my sunset sky.
Faith is the bird that feels the light when the dawn is still dark.
You cannot cross the sea merely by standing and staring at the water.
Flow with whatever is happening and let your mind be free. Stay centered by accepting whatever you are doing.
To a mind that is still, the whole universe surrenders.
You have the right to work, but never to the fruit of work.
The soul is neither born, nor does it die; nor having once been, does it ever cease to be.
Man is made by his belief. As he believes, so he is.
Radiate boundless love towards the entire world above, below, and across unhindered, without ill will, without enmity.
Better than a thousand hollow words, is one word that brings peace.
Sitting quietly, doing nothing, Spring comes, and the grass grows, by itself.
Before enlightenment, chop wood, carry water. After enlightenment, chop wood, carry water.
Obstacles do not block the path; they are the path.
If you realize that all things change, there is nothing you will try to hold on to.
The green reed which bends in the wind is stronger than the mighty oak which breaks in a storm.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
He who knows, does not speak. He who speaks, does not know.
Do not seek to follow in the footsteps of the wise; seek what they sought.
The moon does not reflect in muddy water. Clear your mind, and the truth reflects itself.
Abide in the Unborn mind, where thoughts arise and pass without leaving a trace.
When the student is ready the teacher will appear. When the student is truly ready, the teacher will disappear.
If you cannot imagine yourself working with someone for the rest of your life, don't work with them for a day.
Desire is a contract that you make with yourself to be unhappy until you get what you want.
Play repeated games. All the returns in life, whether in wealth, relationships, or knowledge, come from compound interest.
A fit body, a calm mind, a house full of love. These things cannot be bought - they must be earned.
Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
Stay hungry, stay foolish.
You can't connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backward.
You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
Wind extinguishes a candle and energizes a fire.
Difficulty is what wakes up the genius.
If you don't own your time, you don't own your life.
Pain plus reflection equals progress.
If you're not failing, you're not pushing your limits, and if you're not pushing your limits, you're not maximizing your potential.
When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
Boil things down to the most fundamental truths and reason up from there.
Don't stop when you're tired. Stop when you're done.
You are in danger of living a life so comfortable and soft, that you will die without ever realizing your true potential.
Compare yourself to who you were yesterday, not to who someone else is today.
To stand up straight with your shoulders back is to accept the responsibility of life.
Focus on being productive instead of busy.
What we fear doing most is usually what we most need to do.
You have to dream before your dreams can come true.
Excellence is a continuous process and not an accident.
Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
Take up one idea. Make that one idea your life - think of it, dream of it, live on that idea.
In my whole life, I have known no wise people who didn't read all the time - none, zero.
Spend each day trying to be a little wiser than you were when you woke up.
When you choose a priority, you are choosing what to lose.
If you want to be useful, you have to be willing to be misunderstood.
Whatever scares you, go do it. Fear is a compass, showing you where to grow.
When a person can find no deep sense of meaning, they distract themselves with pleasure.
Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power to choose our response.
Until you make the unconscious conscious, it will direct your life and you will call it fate.
You are what you do, not what you say you'll do.
An unexamined life is taken over by the default settings of society.
If you don't prioritize your life, someone else will.
Real knowledge is intrinsic and built from first principles, not borrowed from authority.
We buy things we don't need with money we don't have to impress people we don't like.
The graveyard is full of indispensable men.
Everyone has two lives, and the second begins when you realize you only have one.
We are quick to forget that the price of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.
In thirty years, it won't matter what shoes you wore, how your hair looked, or what clothes you bought. What will matter is how you lived and who you loved.
Most people do not listen with the intent to understand; they listen with the intent to reply.
You will never reach your destination if you stop and throw stones at every dog that barks.
The trouble is, you think you have time.
People forgive mistakes, but they rarely forgive being made to feel small.
A healthy man wants a thousand things, a sick man only wants one.
The axe forgets, but the tree remembers.
We don't see things as they are, we see them as we are.
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
He who buys what he does not need steals from himself.
Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it is faced.
The person who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
No one on their deathbed ever wished they had spent more time at the office.
The tongue has no bones, but it is strong enough to break a heart.
You can judge a society by how it treats its most vulnerable members.
The heavy burden you carry is often the illusion that you are carrying it alone.
A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
When you drink the water, remember the spring.
It is easier to build strong children than to repair broken men.
You cannot wake a person who is pretending to be asleep.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
We build too many walls and not enough bridges.
The old dog barks not in vain.
When the tree falls, everyone gathers firewood.
The quieter you become, the more you can hear.
You never truly know a person until you see how they treat someone who can do nothing for them.
Time heals almost everything; give time time.
The hardest step to take is always the one that demands you leave your past behind.
We spend our youth trading health for wealth, and our old age trading wealth for health.
When the dust settles, the only things remaining are the kindnesses you extended to others.
The flower that blooms in adversity is the rarest and most beautiful of all.
Your life is shaped by two things: the choices you make and the chances you take.
